description: Request a change to one of the signed-in customer's bookings. Put the new values in changes, using the create_booking field names: start, end, bookingTimezone, delivery_mode, location, description, situation_id or language_pair_id. The change goes through Tolk2Go's change approval flow, so it is not applied at once and the price can change; check tolk2go_interpreting_get_booking afterwards. CBR exam requests cannot be changed: cancel and create a new request instead.
name: tolk2go_interpreting_request_change
title: Request a booking change
